title: Application Security Engineer
company: Legal Counsel - 12 month FTC at Rightmove Greenhouse
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><img style="max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-3-8.png" alt="" width="1001"><strong><br><br></strong></span></p> <p>Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.</p> <p>We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. </p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Application Security Engineer</strong></p> <p><strong>Purpose</strong><br>This is the first engineering hire into Rightmove's growing Application Security function,reporting to the Lead Application Security Engineer. You'll work closely with engineering teamsto deliver day-to-day AppSec capabilities across security tooling, vulnerability management,secure design and threat modelling, while helping shape how Application Security operates asthe function matures.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vulnerability Management & Security Tooling</li> <li>Support the rollout and operation of application security tooling across engineeringrepositories, including SAST, SCA and secrets detection.</li> <li>Triage and classify security findings across repos, driving remediation of the secrets backlog</li> <li>Manage the day-to-day operation of vulnerability management, including findings triage,monitoring and engineering engagement.</li> <li>Maintain engineer-facing guidance for resolving vulnerabilities and requesting exceptions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cloud Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support cloud security posture management through Prisma Cloud, including findings triage,monitoring and engagement with relevant engineering/platform teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering Team Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run a risk-tiered engagement cadence with engineering teams based on SLA compliance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Reviews & Triage</strong></p> <ul> <li>Triage inbound security requests per the AppSec triage SLA</li> <li>Conduct secure design and API security reviews for new services, integrations, and RFCs</li> <li>Review and respond to penetration test requests and third-party integration reviews</li> </ul> <p><strong>Threat Modelling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Facilitate threat modelling sessions using the team's runbook/guide</li> <li>Work with engineering teams to establish and improve threat modelling practices acrosssquads</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process & Documentation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain runbooks and process documentation as the function matures</li> <li>Support recurring review cadences (e.g. access reviews, vulnerability audits)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong><br><strong>Must have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Practical experience in application security, security engineering or a related hands-onsecurity role</li> <li>Able to assess security findings in context, distinguish meaningful risk from tooling noise, andmake pragmatic recommendations to engineering teams.</li> <li>Working proficiency in Python (able to read, modify, and write scripts used for internal tooling)</li> <li>Practical experience with DAST/SAST/SCA/secrets scanning tools (Aikido, Snyk, Semgrep,Checkmarx, or similar)</li> <li>Experience with Prisma Cloud or a comparable cloud-native security platform</li> <li>Comfortable reading code and understanding CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent)</li> <li>Experience running or contributing to threat modelling exercises</li> <li>Comfortable running recurring stakeholder syncs with engineering teams</li> <li>Strong written communication</li> <li>Able to triage and prioritise a high volume of inbound requests independently</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to GCP security controls</li> <li>Familiarity with supply-chain security (npm/PyPI dependency risks)</li> <li>Prior experience in a scaling/greenfield security function</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success in first 6 months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fully ramped on Aikido, independently supporting rollout, triage and day-to-day operations</li> <li>Cloud Security handover complete: backlog triaged, monitoring cadence running</li> <li>Risk-tiered engagement cadence live and running its first full cycle</li> <li>Independently triaging and closing security review requests within SLA</li> <li>Independently facilitating threat modelling sessions with engineering teams</li> <li>Identified and delivered improvements to at least one AppSec process or workflow</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><strong>Life at Rightmove</strong></span></h3> <p>Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>We create value…</strong>by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.</li> <li><strong>We think bigger…</strong>by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.</li> <li><strong>We care deeply…</strong>by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.</li> <li><strong>We move together…</strong>by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.</li> <li><strong>We make a difference…</strong>by focusing on delivering measurable impact.</li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><code><a href="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/culture/" target="_blank"><img style="float: left; max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Job-alerts-1.png" alt="" width="452"></a></code></p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"> </p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"> </p> <p>We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with <strong>89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work</strong>, we’re clearly doing something right!<strong> <br><br><img src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/07/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-1-2.png" alt="" width="1000" style="max-width: 100%;"><br></strong></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><strong><img style="max-width: 100%;">What we offer</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.</li> <li>27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.</li> <li>Contributory stakeholder pension.</li> <li>Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.</li> <li>Competitive compensation package.</li> <li>Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.</li> <li>Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.</li> <li>Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.</li> <li>Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.</li> <li>We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 222, 180);"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-8.png" alt="" width="1000"></span></strong></p> <hr> <h4><em>As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. <br></em><br><em>At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. title: Senior Data Scientist, Payment Intelligence
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3>The role</h3> <p>Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.</p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist within our Payment Intelligence team, you’ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You’ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.</p> <p>At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the end-to-end delivery of models at scale, from initial discovery and feature engineering to production, A/B testing and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and engineering peers to turn complex data into real-time, mission-critical fraud prevention solutions.</li> <li>Raise the team’s collective bar through hands-on technical leadership and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Proactively research and integrate latest developments in ML and payer fraud prevention to drive innovation at GoCardless.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being a self-starter who thrives on taking a vague business problem and owning the journey from the first prototype to a live, measurable solution.</li> <li>An opportunity to introduce and scale advanced architectures to solve high-stakes fraud and payment challenges.</li> <li>Moving beyond execution to help define the technical roadmap for Payer Fraud Prevention, ensuring we leverage the best tools for the job.</li> <li>Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites us</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You hold a degree (or PhD) in a STEM discipline or an equivalent commercial experience.</li> <li>You bring hands-on experience with sophisticated architectures, such as deep learning, graph-based, or sequence-based models (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).</li> <li>You can translate complex ML concepts into practical product solutions and communicate these ideas clearly to non-technical peers.</li> <li>You are comfortable owning the full lifecycle, from deep-dive analysis and feature engineering to prototyping, validation, and live A/B testing.</li> <li>You lead by example, writing clean, high-quality code and raising the team’s technical bar through knowledge sharing and code best practices.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> £99,200 - £148,800</p> <p> </p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">minimum and the mid-point</span> of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Life at GoCardless  </strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our <a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/">values</a>; We <em>start with why </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We<em> act with integrity</em>, always. We <em>care deeply</em> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <em>be humble </em>whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work. </p> <h3><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — <strong>25%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Neurodiverse — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">LGBTQIA+ — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Disabled — <strong>1%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Average age — <strong>33</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Female — <strong>45%</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Male — <strong> 55% </strong></p> <p>We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.</p> <p>If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives <u><a href="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://gocardless.com/about/careers/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1781014616204220&usg=AOvVaw1DeqgyeRfEwEzecwn4oq3j" target="_blank">here</a></u><br><br><strong>Sustainability</strong><br><br>We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability <a href="https://gocardless.com/sustainability"><u>action plan</u> </a>here.</p> <p>Find out more about Life at GoCardless via <a href="http://twitter.com/GoCardlessEng">Twitter</a>, <a href="http://instagram.com/lifeatgocardless">Instagram</a> and <a href="http://linkedin.com/company/gocardless">LinkedIn</a>. </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Lease Administration Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave is seeking a Data Center Senior Lease Analyst to support the administration, accuracy, and ongoing optimization of our growing data center, real estate, and equipment lease portfolio. In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own lease abstraction and interpretation for complex and non-standard data center, real estate, and equipment leases.</li> <li>Review and approve lease abstractions and data entry completed by Lease Analysts and third-party providers, providing quality-control sign-off.</li> <li>Manage critical lease dates, including renewals, terminations, escalations, and notice deadlines.</li> <li>Coordinate with Accounts Payable and DC leadership to ensure timely and accurate lease payments and approvals.</li> <li>Partner with landlords and brokers to resolve billing disputes, reconcile CAM, operating expenses, and tax charges, and confirm lease commencement and rent commencement dates.</li> <li>Perform desk audits of annual operating expense statements to validate charges against lease terms.</li> <li>Interpret complex commercial lease provisions related to rent, taxes, insurance, power usage, cross-connects, and other contractual obligations.</li> <li>Support lease negotiations, amendments, and legal redlines by providing lease administration expertise and historical context.</li> <li>Maintain accurate lease data in CoStar, identify data quality issues, and implement improvements to strengthen controls and reporting.</li> <li>Support ASC 842, IFRS 16, and SOX compliance, including internal and external audit requests, documentation, and data validation.</li> <li>Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, KPI dashboards, critical-date trackers, and briefing materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.</li> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for landlord and broker relationships, including escalations and issue resolution.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, and Legal to ensure timely and accurate lease information.</li> <li>Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.</li> <li>Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.</li> <li>Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.</li> <li>5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex infrastructure portfolios.</li> <li>Strong understanding of ASC 842 / IRFS 16 and lease accounting principles.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and administering complex commercial lease agreements and amendments.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with experience identifying discrepancies and resolving complex lease or billing issues.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</li> <li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.</li> <li>Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.</li> <li>Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.</li> <li>Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You possess excellent communication, organisational, and analytical skills.</li> <li>You are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>You have a proactive mindset with a track record of identifying gaps and driving solutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data conta

You will build the relationships, propositions, programmes, market intelligence and operating mechanisms that help those teams identify the right companies earlier, engage them before platform decisions are established and win them onto CoreWeave.</p> <p>You will build and lead a team spanning priority geographies and regional programmes. Initial focus will include the United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Nordics, Benelux and Israel.</p> <h2><strong>In This Role, You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and execute CoreWeave’s EMEA startup business development strategy, operating plan and investment priorities.</li> <li>Build a systematic view of the regional startup opportunity, identifying the markets, investor portfolios, technology categories and companies most likely to become significant consumers of AI infrastructure.</li> <li>Establish clear criteria for prioritising startups based on technical ambition, compute intensity, funding trajectory, workload timing, leadership quality and strategic value.</li> <li>Build senior relationships with venture capital firms, seed and growth investors, accelerators, universities, research laboratories and founder communities.</li> <li>Develop strategic engagement plans for priority ecosystem organisations and create repeatable mechanisms for portfolio title: Quality Engineer
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the Role We are looking for a Quality Engineer to own test automation across Artificial's product platform. This is a hands-on technical role: we already have a substantial automated test suite - roughly 680 Playwright tests alone, plus extensive backend coverage - but it's grown quickly without a dedicated owner, and needs real structure, consolidation, and meaningful metrics built on top of it. You'll start on Platform, bringing structure to what exists and establishing standards for what gets added next, then extend automation into Transform/customer-configuration testing over time - an area with no automated coverage today, only manual execution by our existing testers, in work that's highly specific to each client. Key Responsibilities Reorganisation and consolidation: Bring coverage, completeness, and integrity to our existing ~680-test Playwright suite (plus extensive backend coverage) - identifying and removing duplication, fixing or removing flaky tests, and establishing clear structure and naming conventions where the suite has outgrown its original organisation Meaningful metrics: Build real, trustworthy metrics off the back of the existing suite - coverage mapped to actual product routes and features (today's closest proxy, Playwright page objects, doesn't map cleanly to routes), pass/fail trends over time, and flaky-test tracking Ongoing addition and maintenance: Own the suite as a living asset, not a one-off clean-up - adding new automated coverage as features ship, maintaining existing tests as the product changes, and keeping the suite healthy on an ongoing basis CI pipeline scaling: The suite has grown 40% in three months (470 to 680 tests) and is now regularly hitting CI resource limits, with an 8-shard stress-test job approaching a 4-hour timeout. Work collaboratively with the QA Lead and Engineering on a real scaling plan for our existing CI pipeline (Buildkite) - this can't just mean adding more runners indefinitely. You'll be closely involved in shaping this, with full ownership expected to grow over time Clarifying automation boundaries: Work with Engineering and FDE teams to establish a clear, documented relationship between platform-level automated tests and FDE "golden tests," removing current ambiguity about what covers what; also align with the performance testing work already underway so load/performance results sit in the same reporting picture rather than a separate silo Mentorship: Support QA Engineers with automation as they need it - helping them write and troubleshoot tests, sharing what you know, and building their confidence over time Reporting integration: Work with the QA Lead to integrate automated test results into the wider test management approach, so a test failure automatically generates a structured bug report linked back to Linear, rather than issues being created manually on an ad-hoc basis as they are today Cross-team collaboration: Work closely with Engineering (who currently own significant existing automation) to agree a clear, documented handover and ongoing collaboration model, avoiding duplicated effort or unclear ownership Building Transform/config automation from scratch: Once Platform is on a solid footing, extend automated coverage into FDE/customer-configuration testing - an area that has no automated coverage today, only manual execution by our existing testers. Unlike the Platform work above, this genuinely starts with nothing, in an area that's highly specific to each client rather than standard across the platform About You Strong hands-on experience building and owning test automation frameworks at scale, not just writing individual automated tests Deep experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, including framework design and CI/CD integration Comfortable working in or around a codebase - reading and reasoning about application code, even if not writing production features yourself Experience diagnosing and resolving flaky or unreliable automated tests, and designing tests to avoid these problems from the start Experience establishing test coverage visibility/reporting from scratch, where none previously existed - you'll use this directly when the role extends into Transform/config automation, which genuinely starts with nothing today A methodical, standards-driven approach - you think about frameworks and patterns, not just individual test cases Benefits Private medical insurance Income protection insurance Life insurance of 4 * base salary On-site gym and shower facilities Enhanced maternity and paternity pay Team social events and company parties Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform Company stock options managed through Ledgy Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us! Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts. title: Senior Delivery Engineer
description: Hi 👋 I’m Dom Allgood, Client Education Manager at hyperexponential. I joined four years ago as a Curriculum Developer and have spent the last couple of years growing Client Education into the (soon to be) five-person team it is today. Before hx I spent a decade teaching Computing in secondary schools. Outside of work most of my time goes to my two children, and what's left to running and, more recently, mountain biking - where I'm still very much a beginner. Client Education exists to get our customers to value as quickly as possible, and to keep them there. We run instructor-led training, own hx Academy where all our self-paced learning content lives, own the certification programme, and run some of our customer events. We've also recently taken ownership of Developer+, and that's where this role comes in. Our first customers are working through the programme now, and as it grows it will need to evolve based on what we learn from them. This isn't a typical Delivery Engineer role, you'll sit in Client Education rather than Delivery Engineering. You'll still work closely with the wider Delivery Engineering team, but your day to day is the customers on Developer+: delivering workshops, running drop-ins, reviewing their code, and shaping the programme around what you learn doing it. You'll partner with Product too, so customers can adopt new enhancements quickly and smoothly. There's no established playbook for this yet, so what matters most is the drive to build one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to own, I'd love to hear from you. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes — whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision — helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally — already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do — from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Delivery Engineering team The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do. The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries. What you'll be doing Move customer teams from hx-led build to independent delivery, shifting effort from pairing toward review and advisory. Keep every engagement moving to its prescribed path, sequencing services to each customer's build stage. Deliver structured enablement sessions — architecture, coding best practice, testing and deployment, model lifecycles — pitched at each team's level. Run code review as a consistent, standards-anchored service, evolving hx's model development standards where reviews expose gaps. Provide drop-in support shaped by each customer's build stage, resolving most issues in session rather than escalating. Make Developer+ repeatable rather than personality-dependent, documenting delivery and using AI to scale capacity. Convert delivery knowledge into hx Academy content, prioritised by what reviews and drop-ins actually surface. Act as the technical voice of the customer into Product, feeding back recurring friction on a regular rhythm. What you'll need to have done Built deep hx platform expertise and production-grade Python, including testing, deployment and model lifecycles. Have excellent pricing and modelling judgement when working with customer’s - working with insurance & actuarial teams is a plus. Developed strong technical enablement instincts, pitching sessions and documentation at the audience's real level. Coached customer teams to work independently rather than solving problems for them. Operated with high ownership and self-direction, building repeatable process where none exists. Prioritised transparently across competing delivery, review and content demands. Communicated with credibility and clarity across developers, actuaries, delivery partners and internal stakeholders. You're unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn't obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>The Simulator team builds state-of-the-art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo driver. We use machine learning to model the real world, including realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather. To increase the fidelity and steerability of the simulations, we employ large foundation models, trained on our massive datasets that allow us to quickly setup and rollout multiple scenarios to subject our driver to.</p> <p>We have set up a team in London UK to work with the teams in MTV and Oxford to build these foundation models out and to integrate them into several evaluation and training products. We are looking for research engineers to work on these exciting problems.</p> <p>In this hybrid role, you will report to an Engineering Manager.</p> <p> <strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be part of a world class research engineering team to grow the state-of-the-art of ultra realistic AV simulations using foundation models</li> <li>Collaborate with teams in Waymo Oxford to use large models to improve sim realism</li> <li>Design experiments that push the frontiers of AV simulations</li> <li>Develop metrics that measure the realism of simulated worlds</li> <li>Train and evaluate large models and integrate them into the simulator and its downstream applications</li> <li>Help hire outstanding research engineers from diverse backgrounds</li> <li>Be a part of a collaborative research engineering team that takes research ideas and productionizes them</li> </ul> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years experience in applied Deep Learning</li> <li>4+ years coding and design skills</li> <li>Experience solving complex production problems using state-of-the-art ML techniques</li> <li>Experience taking research to production</li> <li>Expertise in Data Analysis or Data Science</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements. </span></p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£123,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£129,000 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior UX Design Engineer
description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. A bit about us: 🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. 🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision. 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. 🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. 💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. Role Overview 🔎 As a Senior UX Design Engineer, you'll own some of the hardest problems in our product and see them through until they're solved. You'll join our design team, three designers today and growing, and work inside our teams alongside product managers and our product, legal and AI engineers (our legal engineers are former real estate lawyers). We've built a product that real estate lawyers rely on, and now we're also building for the businesses that own, occupy and develop property. You'll work across both, and much of it is new ground. Nobody here has the full answer yet, and that's the job: you'll get to know the people we build for, work out what they need from us, and build it. This role is not about polishing screens. Our product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate lawyers and property teams in the world. The hardest design problems here are not about how it looks. They are about whether people can trust it and get their work done. Your starting point is the users, their work and the product: you notice what isn't working, decide what matters most, and see it through, from the first customer conversation to the version they use. Here, designers build what they design. With AI coding tools, you'll build your designs into the product yourself, often live for customers the next day. When anyone can build, judgement matters most, and that is the heart of this role. What You'll Be Doing Find out who you're building for: talk to customers and map who does what inside law firms and property businesses. You'll do it together with the wider team. Design how people work with our AI agents, which do real work on their behalf: what people hand over, how they check it and see where each answer came from, when they step in, what the agent asks about first and what it simply does, and how that shifts as AI improves. Solve first, then refine: get to the right answer with rough, working versions in front of real people, and add polish once the problem is solved. Build and ship interface changes yourself, using AI coding tools in our codebase. Engineering depth is welcome, not required. Keep the product coherent while everyone builds: engineers, legal engineers, product people and coding agents all build interfaces here. Explain why one option beats another so people can make the call themselves, write it down as clear, reusable rules in the codebase for agents to follow, and evolve our design system so it all still feels like one product. New to design engineering? 🌱 Design engineering is still a new kind of role, and most great candidates won't have had the title. If you're a strong designer with a good sense of product, and you're excited about building what you design, we'd love to hear from you. We'll help you make the shift. You should apply if: ✍️ You go after the hard problem, not the surface one, and own it until it's solved. You judge your work by whether people use it, rely on it and come back. You're comfortable not knowing yet. You form a view, test it with real people, and change it when they tell you something different. You bring design excellence and strong product sense: hierarchy, layout, type, copy, states, navigation and flow, and a clear view of what is worth building. You've designed for experts, people who know their field better than any designer will. You reach for patterns they already know, and never talk down to them. You can say why. You make a call and ship it without waiting for sign-off, explain it in words others can reuse, and change your mind for a good reason. You'd rather guide people than overrule them. You're genuinely excited about AI: what it can do, where it's heading and how to get the most out of it. You already design or build with AI tools, at work or in your own projects, and you want to help shape how AI changes the working day of property professionals. You want to learn how property and legal work gets done. No legal or property knowledge needed. You have owned and shipped product design work, and can walk us through the problem, not just the result. Desirable Experience designing AI products: showing the reasoning behind an answer, signalling confidence, and letting people steer an agent. Experience in legal tech, fintech, compliance or another field where precision and professional accountability shape every decision. Side projects, hackathons or things you've built outside work. Design systems and accessibility experience. Experience at an early-stage or fast-scaling startup, where there was no established process and you helped create one. Reasons we might not be for you The pace is fast and our ways of working keep evolving. If you prefer clear boundaries between design and engineering, this may not be the role for you. You'll spend most of your time on hard, unsolved problems and on building, not on perfecting polished mock-ups. Why you'll love it here You'll join a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real. You'll help shape how design works in a company where AI builds alongside people. Your work is used by lawyers and property teams on real deals and real buildings. How we hire A short call with our recruiter. A 30-minute video call with the hiring manager. A design task. A 90-minute panel: you'll walk us through your task, then meet people from across the company. A final conversation with our CTO. Read more How we think about design engineering: Design After the Leap Everyone Ships Code Now Our Product Engineering Guide Benefits 🌟 💰 Competitive salary 🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 📚 £1,000 personal development budget and learning opportunities 🏥 Company pension, healthcare, eye care and enhanced parental leave 🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays, and a Deliveroo budget for late nights 🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme 🎉 Regular team off-sites, shared lunches and social events 🧑‍💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're big on working together in person. This role is based in our London office, several days a week. 🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. 💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you. 💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting . Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements. Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. title: Electric Propulsion Test Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job. As Electric Propulsion Test Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit's own vacuum facilities. You work shoulder to shoulder with our propulsion engineers. You build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design. Responsibilities Plan and build Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries. Design and implement test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing. Assemble and maintain test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities. Test and analyse Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests. Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results. Feed findings back to the design team quickly so each iteration improves on the last. Verify and document Keep clear records of every test configuration and result, giving traceable evidence for system verification and qualification. Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers to integrate and test each new iteration of the ion propulsion system. Requirements Essential Practical electric propulsion testing experience, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances. Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition systems. Working knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters and of plasma physics, diagnostics and ionisation processes. A rigorous approach to test planning, data quality and documentation. Willingness to work extended hours on-site. Nice to have Experience with plasma diagnostics such as Langmuir probes or retarding potential analysers. Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB). Experience with test rig design or hardware verification for flight programmes. We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Product Designer
description: Founding Product Designer (UX/UI & Research) London (Hybrid) | Full-time | £70 - £85K + early-team equity The role We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability. Join Bite as our first in-house designer working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment. Why join Bite The problem is genuinely hard. When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product. You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. There's no design team to inherit and no feature factory to work around. You set the direction, the patterns and the quality bar, and you'll prototype, test and ship rapidly with a small team that can pivot, fast. Your work ships to people who pay. The beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions. What we're building Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive. Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of those changes to every affected file. What you’ll do Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality. Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns. Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint. Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap. Collaborate with the head of product, founders and engineering team to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, ensure technical feasibility and ship product improvements that move the metrics that matter. Analyse product performance to identify friction points and drive iterative optimisation, aligning business goals with user-centred product opportunities. Lead comprehensive user research, including interviews, surveys, behavioural analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights. Translate insights, data, and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and ultimately end-to-end, intuitive design solutions that drive meaningful improvements. Facilitate workshops to build shared understanding and present design decisions clearly to influence strategic, experience-led discussions. Encode the judgment and complexity required for complex workflows under the hood, while keeping the user experience simple and seamless. Stay current on emerging AI trends and product patterns. Build a clear point of view on what matters, and bring that perspective into how we design at Bite. What we need from you A senior or lead product designer with 5+ years of experience (preferably shipping high-quality B2B products, with expertise in AI products). An autonomous, opinionated builder who is comfortable being the sole designer and enjoys facilitating design sprints and principles within an engineering team. A creative excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment. A proven IC track record of expertise across UX/UI research, including interviews, surveys, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and the ability to translate insights into end-to-end digital experiences at scale. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and fluency in data, using qualitative and quantitative signals to validate design decisions, measure impact, and inform tradeoffs. Evidence of shipping work that moved real business or operational metrics, and an ability to talk about those numbers fluently. Demonstrated understanding of human-centred design principles and usability best practices, responsive design, product, technical, and business constraints in real-world environments. Demonstrable ability to build intuitive, user-centred experiences supported by a portfolio showing strong interaction design foundation, high-quality visual craft and attention to detail, structured problem framing and systems thinking. Advanced experience working with AI-native research, design, and collaboration tools and advanced proficiency in Figma. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise, customer-ready documentation. Ability to move fluidly between the big question (what should this experience do?) and the craft-level detail that makes high-stakes decisions feel simple. Highly organised and adaptable, able to balance critical thinking with hands-on delivery, while contributing to the evolution of the design system and culture. Experience working autonomously to design complex, multi-step product flows. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.</h2> <p>SoundCloud is looking for a <strong>Senior Backend Engineer to join our Anti-Abuse Team</strong>, with a mission to keep connections between fans and creators safe and authentic, while building and operating an abuse prevention platform at global scale. The role can be based in either our <strong>Berlin or London</strong> office.</p> <p>Our services are at the heart of SoundCloud’s user journeys. We operate a substantial suite of event-based services, combining specialised and generalised detection approaches to tackle complex architectural problems where scale, adaptability and fast decision-making are critical.</p> <p>You’ll join a self-sufficient team passionate about abuse prevention, building scalable and adaptable solutions that stay ahead of emerging risks. Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and evolve reusable platform capabilities and services that enable other teams to detect and respond to emerging abuse patterns at scale</li> <li>Shape the title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!</p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help embed our software capitalisation process working closely with our engineering and business teams to create an automated and scalable solution.</li> <li>Take on the role of product owner for the financial reporting processes of software capitalisation, operating key controls across month end close and performing impairment assessments.</li> <li>Use your strong technical knowledge of relevant IFRS standards for capitalisation and impairment to support and challenge the business on areas of judgement and documentary evidence.</li> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£60,000 - £65,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: (Junior) PR & Communications Manager EMEA
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? About the Role Statista is seeking a (Junior) PR & Communications Manager to support and shape communications activities across the EMEA region, with a clear focus on Germany and the UK. Reporting to the Head of PR & Communications, you will turn Statista’s data, products, and corporate stories into compelling narratives, proactive media relations, and relevant communications content. This is a hands-on role for a professional at the beginning of their career. You will take ownership of day-to-day PR execution in Germany and the UK while working closely with an international PR & Communications team. The ideal candidate is a strong writer and proactive communicator who understands what makes a story relevant for journalists, enjoys turning complex topics into clear narratives, and is excited to grow their career in a fast-moving global company. If you thrive on making things happen and want to make a real impact by empowering people with data to make fact-based decisions, this is your opportunity. Key Responsibilities Execute day-to-day PR and communications activities across EMEA, with a clear focus on Germany and the UK – in alignment with business objectives and the global communications strategy. Draft, edit, and tailor communications materials in German and English, including press releases, media pitches, op-eds, expert commentary, media alerts, Q&As, briefing documents, and key messages. Help plan and execute always-on media relations activities to secure earned media coverage across Tier 1 and Tier 2 business, technology, trade, national, and podcast media; including monitoring of industry trends and news developments to identify proactive PR opportunities. Support the planning and execution of integrated communications campaigns, including thought leadership and corporate announcements (e.g., product news, business developments). Build and maintain relationships with journalists, editors and relevant industry influencers across German and UK business, technology, national, and trade media. Help position and prepare executives, industry experts, and researchers for media interviews, speaking engagements, and other external appearances to ensure impactful and consistent representation of Statista across the EMEA region. Create and manage LinkedIn content for executives, translating business priorities, data, and thought-leadership topics into authentic, engaging executive communications. Contribute to PR & communications work beyond the core Germany and UK remit where needed, including support for U.S. PR activities, and media outreach across other EMEA markets. Help manage and coordinate PR-related partnerships and external speaking opportunities Qualifications 2–3+ years of relevant professional experience in PR, corporate communications, brand communications, journalism, or a related field, gained in-house or at a PR/communications agency. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English. Strong writing and editing skills, with experience producing high-quality press materials, media pitches, and other editorial content for different audiences. Experience in media relations, including pitching stories that resonate with journalists, responding to media requests, and building relationships with journalists and editors. A good understanding of the German media landscape; an initial understanding of the EMEA region, especially the UK media market and existing relationships with UK journalists are a plus. Ability to identify compelling angles and turn complex information, products, and business topics into clear and relevant stories that resonate with media. A proactive, collaborative, and reliable working style, with the confidence to engage constructively with cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience working within a global organization or agency Experienced in analyzing data and data-led storytelling. Experience supporting executive communications and thought leadership programs. Curiosity about business, technology, AI, and data topics that shape public discussion. Familiarity with AI-enabled communications is a plus. Why Statista At Statista, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions through trusted data and insights. Join us in shaping how businesses, organizations, and individuals understand the world through data. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond.
